'''Grim Destiny''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] team operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It consisted of eight bounty hunters led by [[Garm Trodask]]. Grim Destiny was the team that pursued the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] gangster, [[Mennac Vanderijar|Mennac]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Trendivar]].
